zh.title: 波音子公司 Spirit Defense 參與 FQ-42 Vengeance 生產
zh.summary: 波音子公司 Spirit Defense 將負責 FQ-42 機身設計製造
body: 波音子公司 Spirit Defense 於 2026 年 10 月 23 日宣佈，將作為 General Atomics Aeronautical Systems (GA-ASI) 的 FQ-42 Vengeance 機身設計製造合作夥伴，提供從設計到生產的工程與製造能力。
GA-ASI 已於 2026 年 6 月 17 日獲得首份 FQ-42A 生產合約，美國空軍於 2026 年 9 月確認首批增量涵蓋兩款機型共 150 架。
截至 2026 年 9 月，GA-ASI 表示具備每月交付 6 架 FQ-42 的產能，並擁有額外廠房空間以應對更大訂單。
Spirit Defense 成立於波音 2025 年 12 月 8 日收購 Spirit AeroSystems 後，總部設於堪薩斯州威奇塔，作為波音防務、太空與安全事業部的非整合子公司獨立運營；波音早前曾入選五家 CCA 概念開發商之一，但 2024 年 4 月空軍決定由 GA-ASI 與 Anduril 進入生產代表性測試階段，波音等三家未獲入選。

en.title: Boeing subsidiary Spirit Defense joins General Atomics FQ-42 Vengeance production
en.summary: Spirit Defense to design-build FQ-42 fuselages; US Air Force targets 150 CCA aircraft
body: Boeing subsidiary Spirit Defense announced on October 23, 2026 that it will serve as a fuselage design‑build partner for General Atomics Aeronautical Systems’ FQ‑42 Vengeance, providing engineering and manufacturing from design through production.
GA‑ASI received its initial FQ‑42A production contract on June 17, 2026, and the US Air Force confirmed in September 2026 that the first increment covers 150 aircraft across the two CCA types.
As of September 2026 GA‑ASI said it could deliver six FQ‑42s per month, with additional manufacturing space available for larger orders.

Spirit Defense was created after Boeing’s acquisition of Spirit AeroSystems on December 8, 2025 and operates as a non‑integrated subsidiary of Boeing Defense, Space & Security; Boeing had been among five firms chosen for CCA concepts but was not selected for the production‑representative test phase in April 2024.
